defects: Requires much stronger algebraic structure than the gold: β must be an OrderedAddCommMonoid and a Module R β over an OrderedSemiring R, whereas gold only needs the minimal order-scalar typeclass PosSMulMono α β (built from just Preorder α, Zero α, Preorder β, SMul α β). This restricts the statement to module-like scalar actions and excludes the many non-additive/non-module ordered scalar actions the gold's PosSMulMono covers, so it is a narrower corollary, not the same proposition.

The scalar type R is used in instance binders ([OrderedSemiring R], [Module R β], [OrderedSMul R β]) and in {a : R} but is never declared as a type variable (e.g. {R : Type*}); this relies on autoImplicit, which is disabled by default in Mathlib-style files and would likely fail to elaborate.

Uses the OrderedSMul R β typeclass (a module/ring-based ordered-scalar API) instead of PosSMulMono α β; this is not merely a bundled/unbundled restatement of the same typeclass but a different, more specialized structure.
